source_summary: Panoramic Chinese landscape with misty distant mountains, rolling green-blue hills, lake water, far-shore villages and trees, boats, foreground willows, shrubs, a curved bank path, arched bridge, and dense dark foliage at the right edge.

motifs.name: left_misty_mountain_range
motifs.description: Isolate the pale distant mountain range across the upper left and center-left, including soft triangular peaks, faint overlapping ridgelines, sparse dotted vegetation, and the light mist band that separates the ridges from the lower landscape.
must_preserve: soft ink contour lines of the peaks
small clustered dot-texture vegetation on slopes
faint receding peaks in the central haze

motifs.name: lower_left_island_hillside
motifs.description: Isolate the low rounded island hillside in the lower left lake, including the sloping shoreline, small rocky islets, sparse dotted shrubs, and light green-brown wash texture.
must_preserve: small rocks and islets at the water edge
thin pale wash defining the island form

motifs.name: central_far_shore_village
motifs.description: Isolate the thin middle-distance shoreline settlement running across the center, with low huts, tree clusters, narrow paths, and the gently curving lake bank beneath the hills.
must_preserve: pale grey-green washes behind the structures
curving bank edge separating land from water

motifs.name: right_grand_mountain_mass
motifs.description: Isolate the large rolling mountain mass on the upper right, including its high rounded summit, layered ridges, rocky crown, dotted vegetation, and greenish slope washes.
must_preserve: misty lower edge where the mountain descends toward the shore

motifs.name: right_far_pavilion_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the far-right middle-distance grove and pavilion group along the opposite bank, including the small red-roofed pavilion, adjacent dark tree line, and the small roofed boat-like form to its right.
must_preserve: tiered pavilion roof geometry with red accents
scattered foliage dots at the base
small angular roofed form near the right bank

motifs.name: central_passenger_boat
motifs.description: Isolate the larger covered passenger boat on the open lake, with its long hull, roof canopy, seated figures, oar lines, and subtle reddish interior accents.
must_preserve: muted red-brown color accents inside the boat

motifs.name: small_skiff_with_figures
motifs.description: Isolate the small skiff just right of the passenger boat, including the shallow hull, two small figures, and fine horizontal water placement lines.
must_preserve: minimal pale wash around the skiff
fine dark ink accents defining heads and bodies

motifs.name: foreground_willows_bridge_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the foreground right bank ensemble, including the large drooping willow trees, leafless shrubs, curving path, arched stone bridge, small walking figure, and dense dark foliage mass at the far right.
must_preserve: dark twisting willow trunks and branches
arched bridge geometry and parapet strokes
tiny walking figure on the path
dense stippled dark foliage at the right edge
green-brown bank washes and rock texture

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
